pipeline_params.description: AutoModelRouter: a closed-source TLD router by KT. An mmBERT-based encoder labels Task/Domain/Level, each model's TLD matrix says which cells it may serve, and the cheapest qualifying model is picked. Tencent HY4 Flash serves Math Problem Solving (T3) and Code (T4); Gemini 3 Flash Preview (reasoning off) serves Health/Medicine (D4); Gemini 3.8 Flash (reasoning low) serves everything else.
